source: MyCobot280 RobotLimit table in pymycobot v4.0.6 (https://github.com/elephantrobotics/pymycobot/blob/v4.0.6/pymycobot/robot_info.py). Based on the November 9, 2026 Pi controller readback, with operator-specified caps of +/-135 degrees for J2 and +/-145 degrees for J4. These offline bounds carry no physical travel verification.
